definitions.explanation: An organ behind the stomach that produces digestive enzymes and hormones including insulin. Essential for both digestion and blood sugar regulation.

notes:
FUNCTIONS:
The {膵臓|すいぞう} has two main functions:
1. ⟦{外分泌|がいぶんぴつ}→外分泌：noentry⟧: Producing digestive enzymes
2. ⟦{内分泌|ないぶんぴつ}→内分泌：noentry⟧: Producing hormones (insulin, glucagon)

- ⟦{膵炎|すいえん}→膵炎：noentry⟧: pancreatitis
- ⟦{膵臓癌|すいぞうがん}→膵臓癌：29066_suizougan⟧: pancreatic cancer
- ⟦{膵液|すいえき}→膵液：noentry⟧: pancreatic juice

LOCATION:
Situated behind the ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧ (stomach), near the ⟦{十二指腸|じゅうにしちょう}→十二指腸：29068_juunishichou⟧ (duodenum).
